SEST award artwork - Southern Watch

Code-drawn strips (integration/campaign/service_awards.py). No AI imagery;
nothing traced. Real-award strips follow the published stripe order and
proportions closely enough to be recognised; they are representations.
  sest_southern_watch_service.png - Southern Watch Service Ribbon: fictional SEST design
  sest_northern_lifeline.png - Timor Corridor Ribbon: fictional SEST design
  sest_archipelago_operations.png - Archipelago Operations Ribbon: fictional SEST design
  australian_commendation_distinguished_service.png - Commendation for Distinguished Service: representation of the Australian award
  uk_obe_military.png - Officer of the Order of the British Empire (Military): representation of the British award
  uk_distinguished_service_order.png - Distinguished Service Order: representation of the British award
  australian_meritorious_unit_citation.png - Australian Meritorious Unit Citation: representation of the Australian award

Installed Sea Power pictures referenced by path, not copied into this pack:
  campaigns/pacific-strike-task-force/art/ribbons/navy_commendation_medal_ribbon.png - Navy and Marine Corps Commendation Medal
  campaigns/pacific-strike-task-force/art/ribbons/australian_distinguished_service_cross_ribbon.png - Australian Distinguished Service Cross
  campaigns/pacific-strike-task-force/art/ribbons/bronze_star_medal_ribbon.png - Bronze Star Medal
  campaigns/pacific-strike-task-force/art/ribbons/jmsdf_defense_memorial_cordon_ribbon.png - 1st Class Commendation (Defense Memorial Cordon)
  campaigns/pacific-strike-task-force/art/ribbons/navy_achievement_medal_ribbon.png - Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal (no longer granted)
  campaigns/pacific-strike-task-force/art/ribbons/navy_unit_commendation_ribbon.png - Navy Unit Commendation (no longer granted)

Royal Navy emblem (ui/campaign/navy_emblems/sest_rn_emblem.png): the White Ensign,
from the SEST gallery flag set (File:Naval ensign of the United Kingdom.svg, Wikimedia
Commons, public domain; credited in Gallery/VISUAL_CREDITS.txt), scaled by build_pack.py.

Award facts (criteria, ribbon design, precedence):
  Commendation for Distinguished Service: https://www.defence.gov.au/adf-members-families/honours-awards/australian-awards/commendation-distinguished-service
  Navy and Marine Corps Commendation Medal: https://www.secnav.navy.mil/doni/SECNAV%20Manuals1/1650.1.pdf
  Officer of the Order of the British Empire (Military): https://www.royalnavy.mod.uk/news/2024/december/30/20241230-new-years-and-op-honours
  Australian Distinguished Service Cross: https://www.defence.gov.au/sites/default/files/2025-01/Fact-Sheet-Distinguished-Service-Cross.pdf
  Bronze Star Medal: https://uscode.house.gov/us/usc/t10/s1133/
  Distinguished Service Order: https://www.thegazette.co.uk/London/issue/62529/supplement/326/data.pdf
  1st Class Commendation (Defense Memorial Cordon): http://www.clearing.mod.go.jp/kunrei_data/a_fd/1955/ax19550810_00049_000.pdf
  Australian Meritorious Unit Citation: https://www.pmc.gov.au/honours-and-symbols/list-australian-honours/meritorious-unit-citation
  Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal: https://www.secnav.navy.mil/doni/SECNAV%20Manuals1/1650.1.pdf
  Navy Unit Commendation: https://www.secnav.navy.mil/doni/SECNAV%20Manuals1/1650.1.pdf

Every real-award citation says it is a game award for a fictional operation,
not a real honour.
